headline: New York Times in Advanced Talks to Acquire Letterboxd
summary: The New York Times Company is in advanced negotiations to acquire the cinephile community site Letterboxd for approximately $330 million.
why: Acquisitions of niche digital platforms are often used by media companies to diversify revenue streams and expand their subscriber base.

impacts.name: New York Times Company
impacts.why: Large cash outlays for acquisitions can impact short-term liquidity and balance sheet composition.
